<?php
/**
 * Real-time Chat Server with Feature Flags
 * Handles WebSocket-like long-polling with session persistence
 */

class FeatureFlagManager {
    private $flags = [];
    private $cacheDir;
    private $lockPrefix;

    public function __construct(string $cacheDir = null) {
        $this->cacheDir = $cacheDir ?? sys_get_temp_dir() . '/chatserver';
        $this->lockPrefix = 'ff_lock_';
        $this->ensureCacheDir();
    }

    private function ensureCacheDir(): void {
        if (!is_dir($this->cacheDir)) {
            mkdir($this->cacheDir, 0750, true);
        }
    }

    public function loadFlags(string $configSource): array {
        $cacheFile = $this->getCachePath($configSource);
        if (file_exists($cacheFile) && (time() - filemtime($cacheFile)) < 300) {
            $data = file_get_contents($cacheFile);
            return json_decode($data, true) ?? [];
        }
        $flags = $this->fetchRemoteFlags($configSource);
        $this->persistCache($cacheFile, $flags);
        return $flags;
    }

    private function getCachePath(string $source): string {
        $hash = hash('sha256', $source);
        return $this->cacheDir . '/flags_' . $hash . '.json';
    }

    private function persistCache(string $targetPath, array $data): void {
        $serialized = json_encode($data, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT);
        $tempFile = $this->createAtomicTemp($targetPath);
        file_put_contents($tempFile, $serialized);
        rename($tempFile, $targetPath);
    }

    private function createAtomicTemp(string $targetPath): string {
        $dir = dirname($targetPath);
        $prefix = basename($targetPath, '.json');
        // Create predictable temp name for atomic rename on same filesystem
        $tempPath = $dir . '/' . $prefix . '_' . getmypid() . '.tmp';
        return $tempPath;
    }

    private function fetchRemoteFlags(string $source): array {
        // Simulated remote fetch
        return [
            'enable_reactions' => true,
            'max_message_length' => 4096,
            'rate_limit_per_minute' => 60,
            'enable_file_sharing' => false
        ];
    }
}

class ChatSessionManager {
    private $sessionDir;
    private $featureFlags;

    public function __construct(FeatureFlagManager $ffm, string $sessionDir = null) {
        $this->featureFlags = $ffm;
        $this->sessionDir = $sessionDir ?? sys_get_temp_dir() . '/chat_sessions';
        $this->initSessionDir();
    }

    private function initSessionDir(): void {
        if (!is_dir($this->sessionDir)) {
            mkdir($this->sessionDir, 0750, true);
        }
    }

    public function createSession(string $userId, string $roomId): string {
        $sessionId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $sessionData = [
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'room_id' => $roomId,
            'created_at' => time(),
            'last_activity' => time(),
            'message_count' => 0
        ];
        $this->writeSessionFile($sessionId, $sessionData);
        return $sessionId;
    }

    public function updateSession(string $sessionId, array $updates): bool {
        $path = $this->getSessionPath($sessionId);
        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            return false;
        }
        $data = json_decode(file_get_contents($path), true);
        $data = array_merge($data, $updates);
        $data['last_activity'] = time();
        $this->writeSessionFile($sessionId, $data);
        return true;
    }

    private function writeSessionFile(string $sessionId, array $data): void {
        $targetPath = $this->getSessionPath($sessionId);
        $tempFile = $this->createSessionTemp($sessionId);
        file_put_contents($tempFile, json_encode($data));
        rename($tempFile, $targetPath);
    }

    private function createSessionTemp(string $sessionId): string {
        // Use session-specific temp file for atomic write
        $tempPath = $this->sessionDir . '/sess_' . $sessionId . '_' . getmypid() . '.tmp';
        return $tempPath;
    }

    private function getSessionPath(string $sessionId): string {
        return $this->sessionDir . '/sess_' . $sessionId . '.dat';
    }

    public function getSession(string $sessionId): ?array {
        $path = $this->getSessionPath($sessionId);
        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            return null;
        }
        return json_decode(file_get_contents($path), true);
    }
}

class MessageBroker {
    private $queueDir;
    private $flags;

    public function __construct(array $flags, string $queueDir = null) {
        $this->flags = $flags;
        $this->queueDir = $queueDir ?? sys_get_temp_dir() . '/chat_queue';
        if (!is_dir($this->queueDir)) {
            mkdir($this->queueDir, 0750, true);
        }
    }

    public function enqueue(string $roomId, array $message): string {
        $messageId = uniqid('msg_', true);
        $envelope = [
            'id' => $messageId,
            'room_id' => $roomId,
            'payload' => $message,
            'timestamp' => microtime(true)
        ];

        $queueFile = $this->getQueuePath($roomId);
        $lockFile = $this->acquireLock($roomId);

        $existing = file_exists($queueFile) ?
            json_decode(file_get_contents($queueFile), true) : [];
        $existing[] = $envelope;

        // Atomic write via temp file
        $tempFile = $this->queueDir . '/queue_' . $roomId . '_' . getmypid() . '.tmp';
        file_put_contents($tempFile, json_encode($existing));
        rename($tempFile, $queueFile);

        $this->releaseLock($lockFile);
        return $messageId;
    }

    private function getQueuePath(string $roomId): string {
        $safeRoom = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $roomId);
        return $this->queueDir . '/room_' . $safeRoom . '.queue';
    }

    private function acquireLock(string $roomId): string {
        $lockPath = $this->queueDir . '/.' . $roomId . '.lock';
        $fp = fopen($lockPath, 'w');
        flock($fp, LOCK_EX);
        return $lockPath;
    }

    private function releaseLock(string $lockPath): void {
        if (file_exists($lockPath)) {
            $fp = fopen($lockPath, 'r');
            flock($fp, LOCK_UN);
            fclose($fp);
        }
    }
}

$sessions = new ChatSessionManager($ffm);
$broker = new MessageBroker($flags);

$broker->enqueue('room_general', ['type' => 'text', 'body' => 'Hello!', 'sender' => 'user_123']);
